steps-not-a-list.json: steps: a list of at most 50 items
step-arguments-not-object.json: step s1: arguments must be an object
step-force-call-not-boolean.json: step s1: force_call must be a boolean
step-draft-subject-empty.json: step s1: draft_subject must be a non-empty string
step-probes-invalid.json: step s1: probes = at most 10 {header, needle}
seed-not-list.json: seed: a list of at most 10 folders
seed-no-messages.json: seed Local Folders/Inbox: messages = 1 to 20 strings
xpi-traversal.json: xpi: a path relative to the received tree
xpi-not-xpi.json: xpi: a path relative to the received tree
inspect-files-traversal.json: inspect.files: at most 10 paths relative to the profile
checks-missing.json: checks: a list of 1 to 200 checks
checks-empty.json: checks: a list of 1 to 200 checks
check-xfail-empty.json: check tool_ok: xfail must be a string of 1-500 characters
check-note-not-string.json: check tool_ok: note must be a string of 1-500 characters
lab-value-later-step.json: reviewId: $lab_value names 's2', not an earlier step outside this batch
lab-value-same-batch.json: reviewId: $lab_value names 's0', not an earlier step outside this batch
lab-keys-bad-key-name.json: step s1: labKeys keys = 1 to 10 key names
lab-keys-in-batch.json: step s1: labKeys is not in a batch and has no retry
check-count-without-equals.json: check tool_result_count: step, contains = a non-empty string, equals = an integer >= 0
